parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: A list of instance IDs. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The instance name. Fuzzy matching is supported.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- Desc: descending order.

- Asc: ascending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the dataset acceleration instance list. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of dataset acceleration instances to display on each page for a paged query. The default value is 10.

parameters.name: PaymentType
parameters.description:
The billing method of the dataset acceleration instance. Valid values:

- PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go.

- Subscription: subscription.

parameters.name: Phase
parameters.description:
The status of the dataset acceleration instance. Valid values:

- Created: initialization.

- Running: running.

- Stopped: stopped.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the dataset acceleration instance. For more information, see Product specifications. Valid values:

- basic: Basic Edition.

- enhanced: Enhanced Edition.
